fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: What participants see, what we keep and who can watch.

default.question: Do participants know they are being recorded?
default.answer: Always. Fieldnote announces itself when it joins a call, and you can attach a consent form to every invite.

default.question: Can participants join from a phone?
default.answer: Yes. They join your usual video call from any device, with nothing to install.

default.question: Who can see our interviews?
default.answer: Only people in your workspace. You decide who can watch full recordings and who only sees approved highlights.

default.question: Can we delete a recording for good?
default.answer: Yes. Deleting removes the video, audio and transcript right away, and our backups forget it within 30 days.
